title: Image requests get better size handling
summary:
A tuning day: cleaner image sizing, more reliable model access, and less manual deployment and announcement work.

Image generation now handles requested dimensions more cleanly, with Seedream configuration brought into line as well. Fewer surprises between the size you ask for and the pixels that arrive.

The enter proxy now forwards headers correctly and restores model access, while the Kontext registry was aligned with its actual configuration. Azure OpenAI Nano 5 also joined the configured model lineup.

A CI/CD pipeline now handles enter-services deployments, and PR review plus Discord announcement automation keeps changes moving and the community informed without someone repeatedly pressing the same buttons.
